spec_match.rationale: Observes the exact Appendix A sentence — computed values unaffected by used-value truncation/repetition — by dialling background-image count against background-position list length and reading getComputedStyle back; mirrors the WPT background-position-computed multi-base cases.

interactive.rationale: Two segmented button groups drive both list lengths; the painted stage shows the used value while the readout shows the computed list and a preserved/equalised verdict on every change.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises independent dials plus a preserved-vs-truncated readback verdict; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Truncation, repetition and the matched-lengths-indistinguishable case are all handled with distinct verdicts; deeper edges (none-layer, inherit, shorthand serialisation) deliberately live on the sibling pages.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5144333908049920 and the Appendix A spec section.

conformance.rationale: The new feature suite asserts exactly these contracts (truncation and repetition independence per longhand) with probes verified to return false on Chromium 141 (2 pass / 7 fail observed) and true per spec on 158.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless via CDP: all image-count and entry-count combinations exercised; truncation ('10px 10px'), repetition ('10px 10px ×3') and matched-length verdicts all observed exactly as ground-truth probes predicted; console clean; both viewports screenshot-verified. The preserved verdict branch is the same code path reading a different engine value, so the page fully demonstrates the pre-158 side and honestly reports it.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the probe ran, the preserved contract on independent engines, and the equalised fallback explicitly labelled honest-unsupported on older ones.

design_system.rationale: All chrome uses design-system variables; the gradient dots use accent variables with no text on them; segmented buttons invert to black/ivory with a blue outline when pressed.

accessibility.rationale: Fieldset/legend-labelled native button groups (44px targets), the stage carries role=img with a description tied to the live readout, single polite readout region.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3; fieldsets stack and segments stay tappable; both classes screenshot-verified.

openQuestions.title: Capture the PRESERVED verdict on real Chrome 158+/Canary
openQuestions.detail: On this container only the equalised branch could execute (Chromium 141 lacks CSSBackgroundLayerCountIndependence even as a flag). Run the page on Chrome 158, or Chromium ≥ the flag's landing with --enable-blink-features=CSSBackgroundLayerCountIndependence, and confirm the PRESERVED verdict plus the computed-list-preserved telemetry assert.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: The role=img stage description and group labels were set per guidance but not inspected in the accessibility tree because chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable (project rule 7b).

guidanceConsulted.query: segmented button control groups that reflow on narrow mobile viewports
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap control groups with flex-wrap inside auto-fit grid columns so nothing overflows.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The two fieldsets sit in repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 15rem), 1fr)) and the segments flex-wrap; buttons have min 44px square targets.

guidanceConsulted.query: labelling a visual demo stage for screen readers
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give purely visual output an accessible description instead of leaving it silent.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The stage is role=img with aria-label and aria-describedby pointing at the live readout that carries the equivalent text.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Size stages with intrinsic units, not viewport-height traps.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The stage is a fixed 7.5rem tall block with percentage width; no vh units anywhere.

summary: Canonical probe verified end-to-end on Chromium 141 headless: every dial combination produced the predicted truncated/repeated/matched verdicts with the painted dots following used values, console clean, both viewports pass. The preserved branch is pinned by the conformance suite and needs a Chrome 158 capture.
